description_en: Installs the CloudMonitor agent on non-Alibaba Cloud ECS servers
description_zh: 非阿里云ECS服务器安装云监控客户端
kebab_example: aliyun sas install-pm-agent --uuids inet-a6444920-d303-4ccf-ab87-a1d3cd490000 --type aliyun_monitor --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InstallPmAgent

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The list of server UUIDs. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 服务器UUID列表，多个服务器UUID之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en:
The type of the O&M plugin. Valid values:
aliyun_monitor: CloudMonitor agent
parameters.help_zh:
运维插件类型。
aliyun_monitor：表示云监控插件
parameters.name: type

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
